Subject: AstraVantage: Post-Sign Handoff & Kickoff Prep
Attachments: signed_MSA.pdf (pdf), AV-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Team —

Thanks again to everyone for moving quickly on this. AstraVantage signed the MSA yesterday (attached) and committed to a June 30 go-live for their first integration (payment reconciliation pipeline). High-level notes and immediate asks for CS below so we can hit the runway: 

Deal context (quick):
- Total ARR: $420k first 12 months; opportunity to expand into analytics seat add-ons in Q4.
- SKU: Redwood Dedicated (single-tenant) + Optimize package.
- Key contacts: Laura Bennett (Liaison/PM), Tom Hsu (Infra lead), Procurement (procurement@astravantage.com).

Committed deliverables/SLAs (from SOW):
- Production latency SLO: p95 <= 280ms for inference requests.
- Staging environment ready by 2027-06-10.
- Data residency: US-east only.

Immediate CS asks (proposed owner actions):
1) Confirm primary implementation lead and schedule 30–45m pre-kickoff (technical intake).
2) Share onboarding MAP (attached) and the signed MSA with CS for any legal/ops notes.
3) Confirm logistics for SSO (SAML) and VPC peering; customer says they prefer SSO + VPC.
4) Collect sample dataset and schema (customer indicated they can share CSV sample).

Risks to flag: procurement still finalizing payment instrument (Procurement team copied) — could delay resource spin-up if not cleared in 72h. Also, AstraVantage will require an audit log export for compliance; recommend we route that to the Security team early.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5467123/DEAL-AV-0246

Action items: please reply with owner assignment and availability for the pre-kickoff. I've cc'd customer so they can confirm availability.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks — I’ll take point. Quick intake checklist/questions before I reach out to Laura/Tom: 

1) Environment: Confirming Dedicated single-tenant in us-east (per SOW). Any change requests?
2) SSO: Customer expects SAML; do we have the SAML metadata exchange doc we should send them before the tech call?
3) Data sample: need one CSV (<= 50MB) and a schema doc — Karthik, can you confirm Tom is the contact for that?
4) Network: VPC peering or transit gateway? If peer, who owns the cloud account/owner?
5) Acceptance criteria: list of three things for go-live (staging validation, performance baseline, and security checklist) — I'll use the MAP attached as the baseline.

Proposed pre-kickoff windows (PT):
- Mon 2027-05-31 10:00–10:45
- Tue 2027-06-01 09:00–09:45

I’ll draft an agenda (30m) covering architecture review, data expectations, and milestone calendar. Monica — can you confirm you’ll cover audit-log export requirements on the call?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference

Hi Tessa / team —

Great to be moving forward. Availability works for the May 31 slot at 10am PT. Tom will join for the technical portion. 

Answers to your checklist:
- Environment: Confirmed, us-east single-tenant.
- SSO: We will use SAML; Tom will share our IdP metadata in advance.
- Data: attaching a small sample (inbound_data_sample.csv) and a short schema note in the body — this is representative of the ingest.
- Network: We prefer VPC peering; cloud account details will be provided by Tom on the kickoff.

Procurement will share the final payment confirmation by end of day today; copying them so they can follow up.

Two asks for CS before kickoff: 
1) Any guidance on PII redaction expectations during ingestion? We typically anonymize at source but would like recommended best practices.
2) Can you confirm runbook access levels for our SREs post-live?

Thanks — look forward to the call.
